description: Defines the CookiePartitionKey class used for managing cookie partitioning, serialization, and deserialization within the Chromium project. Includes methods for creating, comparing, and serializing cookie partition keys based on URLs, sites, and network isolation keys.

classes.name: CookiePartitionKey
classes.description: Represents a key used for cookie partitioning, supporting serialization, deserialization, and creation from URLs, sites, and network isolation keys.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a CookiePartitionKey into a string if possible.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a CookiePartitionKey, indicating if the key is valid.

methods.name: FromURLForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CookiePartitionKey from a URL for testing purposes.

methods.name: FromNetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Creates a CookiePartitionKey from a NetworkIsolationKey.

methods.name: FromWire
methods.description: Creates a CookiePartitionKey from a SchemefulSite and optional nonce.

methods.name: FromScript
methods.description: Creates a transient CookiePartitionKey indicating it was created from a script.

methods.name: FromStorageKeyComponents
methods.description: Creates a CookiePartitionKey from site components and optional nonce, checking if cookie partitioning is enabled.

methods.name: site
methods.description: Returns the site associated with the cookie partition key.

methods.name: from_script
methods.description: Indicates whether the key was created from a script.

methods.name: IsSerializeable
methods.description: Checks if the current key can be serialized.

methods.name: nonce
methods.description: Returns the optional nonce associated with the key.
